1479-2443-2841-8337.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Evolving Wilds.
1479-2443-2841-8337.description:
Fetch a land using Evolving Wilds.
When the fetched land enters, M'Ress and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and M'Ress trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the M'Ress trigger from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, M'Ress triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

678-997-5865.notablePrerequisites: An opponent has lost life this turn
678-997-5865.description:
Cast Flamecache Gecko by paying its mana cost.
When Flamecache Gecko enters, it triggers, adding {B}{R}.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Flamecache Gecko.
When Flamecache Gecko dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Flamecache Gecko from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

2510-2701-6072-7182.notablePrerequisites: There is a creature card exiled with Semblance Anvil.
2510-2701-6072-7182.description:
Cast Dark Ritual by paying {B}, adding {B}{B}{B}
Cast Graveshifter for its evoke cost by paying {2} due to Semblance Anvil
When Graveshifter enters, its first ability and evoke abilities trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, optionally returning a card from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the second trigger, sacrificing Graveshifter.
When Graveshifter dies, Ashling triggers, creating a token copy of Graveshifter with haste.
When the Graveshifter token enters, it triggers, returning Graveshifter from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2946-4616-4871-5670.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 2 or higher.
2946-4616-4871-5670.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
2946-4616-4871-5670.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Moldervine Reclamation and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Moldervine Reclamation trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and draw a card.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Myth Unbound

708-2459-3899-4948.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Rograkh.
Choose to have Rograkh return to the command zone from your graveyard.
Myth Unbound and Estrid's Invocation trigger, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Cast Rograkh from the command zone by paying {0} due to the cost reductions from Myth Unbound and Estrid's Invocation.
Repeat.

1011-2728-6797-6854.easyPrerequisites:
Genestealer Patriarch does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent controls a creature.
1011-2728-6797-6854.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional creatures.
1011-2728-6797-6854.description:
Declare Genestealer Patriarch as an attacker.
Genestealer Patriarch's first ability triggers, putting an infection counter on a creature an opponent controls.
Cast Fate Transfer by paying its cost, moving the infection counter from the opponent's creature onto a creature you control.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the creature with an infection counter on it.
When the creature dies, Host of the Hereafter and Genestealer Patriarch's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Host of the Hereafter trigger, putting an infection counter onto another creature you control.
Resolve the Genestealer Patriarch trigger, causing you to create a token copy of the sacrificed creature that is a Tyranid in addition to its other types.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat from step 4.

277-4772-6441-6753-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Tiller Engine triggers eight times, untapping the New Planets.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

2440-2703-7730.description:
Activate Myr Propagator by paying {3} and tapping it, creating a token copy of it.
When the Myr Propagator token enters the battlefield, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Myr you control.
Repeat using the Myr Propagator token instead.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness, with a +1/+1 counter on it and with power 3 or greater

5195-5895-7487.description:
Cast Splash Portal by paying {U}, targeting Zealous Lorecaster
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve Splash Portal, blinking Zealous Lorecaster
When Zealous Lorecaster enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Splash Portal to your hand from your graveyard.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Repeat.

2034-3197-7363.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
2034-3197-7363.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token and a Mutagen token due to Donatello.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Activate the Mutagen by paying {1}, tapping and sacrificing it, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with three or more charge counters on it

1978-4563-7170.description:
Animate Everflowing Chalice using Living Brain.
Activate Everflowing Chalice by tapping it, adding at least {C}{C}{C}
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Everflowing Chalice.
Repeat from step 2.

250-779-1479-5702-6620.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1479-5702-6620.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Springheart Nantuko and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Sylvan Safekeeper by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Sylvan Safekeeper ability
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

57-1753-2751-4846.notablePrerequisites: You control any number of permanents that enter untapped and that can collectively tap to produce at least {4}{R}.
57-1753-2751-4846.description:
Activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least {4}{R}.
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Holding priority, activate Strionic Resonator by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Feldon's ability targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Resolve the copy of Feldon's ability, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
Resolve the Feldon ability from step 2, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token created in step 4 leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

277-2653-5702-6973.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
277-2653-5702-6973.description:
Play a land.
When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Mutable Explorer.
When the Mutable Explorer token enters, it triggers, creating a Mutavault land token that enters tapped.
When the Mutavault token enters, Springheart Nantuko, Tiller Engine and Nissa trigger.
Resolve the Tiller Engine trigger, untapping the Mutavault token.
Holding priority, activate the Mutavault token by tapping it, adding {C}.
Resolve the Nissa trigger, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Mutable Explorer.
Repeat from step 3.

1414-2511-2866-4986.description:
Cast Lotus Petal by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Lotus Petal by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Lotus Petal from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

1778-3967-5220-6900.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Memnite
When Memnite dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Memnite from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Cast Memnite from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

1251-2457-4289-6705.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the creature tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

5636-5742-5743-6441.description:
Activate Psychic Frog by discarding Gilded Assault Cart.
Mary Read and Anne Bonny triggers, creating two tapped Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Psychic Frog ability.
Activate Gilded Assault Cart by sacrificing two Treasures, returning Gilded Assault Cart from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.n: Valentin, Dean of the Vein // Lisette, Dean of the Root

323-2034-3097-3490.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Falkenrath Noble triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and an opponent to lose 1 life.
Lisette triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Animation Module triggers for each counter placed this way.
Resolve the first trigger, choosing to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve all other triggers, choosing not to pay.
Repeat.

586-2292-2510-5258-5618.notablePrerequisites: There is a creature card exiled with Semblance Anvil.
586-2292-2510-5258-5618.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability from step 1, causing you to scry 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {1}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

1116-1874-3240-5670.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
1116-1874-3240-5670.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by sacrificing Nether Traitor and paying 1 life.
When Nether Traitor dies, Sek'Kuar triggers, creating a 3/1 Graveborn creature token.
When the Graveborn enters the battlefield, Ajani's Welcome triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing the Graveborn.
When the Graveborn dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Nether Traitor enters the battlefield, Ajani's Welcome triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat.

3661-4452-5852.notablePrerequisites: Rukarumel on the battlefield with "Sliver" chosen
3661-4452-5852.description:
Cast Shield Sphere by paying {0}, and choosing to pay its replicate cost an arbitrarily large number of times by paying {0}.
Shield Sphere triggers, creating a copy of it for each time its replicate cost was paid.
Resolve all Shield Sphere spells, causing the nontoken Shield Sphere to enter the battlefield, and creating a token copy of it for each time its replicate cost was paid.

647-1365-3723-5112-5284.notablePrerequisites: Mairsil does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
647-1365-3723-5112-5284.description:
Activate Mairsil using Cauldron of Souls' ability by tapping it, giving itself persist until end of turn.
Activate Mairsil using Blood Vassal's ability by sacrificing it, adding {B}{B}.
When Mairsil dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Activate Mairsil using Carnifex Demon's ability by paying {B} and removing a -1/-1 counter from it, putting a -1/-1 counter on each other creature.
Repeat.

338-2060-3497-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Freed from the Real attached to Ezzaroot Channeler.
Light of Promise attached to Crystalline Crawler.
Ezzaroot Channeler does not have summoning sickness.
338-2060-3497-4222.description:
Activate Ezzaroot Channeler by tapping it, causing you to gain two life.
Crystalline Crawler triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on itself.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Ezzaroot Channeler.
Repeat.

2034-2308-2842.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2034-2308-2842.description:
Gain any amount of life.
Trudge Garden triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a 4/4 Fungus Beast creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Fungus Beast, adding {C}{C}.
When the Fungus Beast dies, Blood Artist triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.
